The first release candidate of the 2.17.1 line of the NPMplus Security Fork, for test servers ahead of a stable release.

### Action required

None - routine update. The new permission and per-host columns migrate automatically during Safe update and existing enrollments, access lists and rules are preserved; the installer is now v1.72.

### Security

- Two upstream reconciliations landed without giving up a fork protection: single-use second factors, session revocation, CrowdSec telemetry and the fail-closed defaults all survive the new admin permission model.
- The CrowdSec runtime now requires the patched Alpine OpenSSL, and the CrowdSec, Anubis and Caddy images were rebuilt on the newest Go toolchains; all three scan clean at medium severity and above.
- Login handling hardened: the nginx auth gate, the version and report routes keep their guards, saved browser sessions are validated immediately, and a rejected or missing admin session returns to login instead of a broken dashboard.
- Pinned patched body-parser, multer, qs, minimatch and decode-uri-component close their published advisories.

### Changed

- The base moved from 2.15.1 to 2.17.1: nginx 1.31.10, Caddy 2.11.9, the admin permission model with renamed per-host disable flags, and the relocated Swagger page. Existing databases migrate through the new columns under the safe updater's matching snapshot and rollback.
- Installer recovery hardened through v1.72: staged complete snapshots before replacement, rollback coordinated with the firewall bouncer's startup gate, and an older setup script refuses to run over a newer install.

### Fixed

- Existing proxy, redirect, dead and stream hosts regenerate correctly on startup after the upstream refactor, with real-container restart regressions covering the upgrade path.
- Report counts for access lists and certificates are correct again, and access-list password hashing no longer blocks the event loop.

### Upgrade

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.17.1-mangyan1.rc.1/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.17.1-mangyan1.rc.1/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed one. Safe update repairs known configuration drift before the normal snapshot, health check, and automatic rollback protection.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
